title: Omniagent
tagline: AI-powered cross-chain DAO governance and treasury optimization platform.

prizes.title: Best dApp built on Saga Chainlet

description:
OmniAgent is an AI-first DAO governance platform designed to automate proposal generation, treasury strategy, and on-chain execution. By combining GPT-4 with real-time market and treasury data, OmniAgent helps DAOs make smarter, faster, and risk-aware decisions.

It supports cross-chain asset tracking, confidence-scored proposal creation, and fully auditable on-chain execution via secure smart contracts. The intuitive frontend is wallet-enabled through Dynamic Labs and is accessible across devices.

DAOs using OmniAgent shift from manual governance to intelligent, scalable coordination.
how_its_made:
OmniAgent is built using Next.js 15 with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui for a responsive, accessible frontend. Dynamic Labs powers wallet onboarding and user session management, while Wagmi + Viem handle blockchain interactions. The backend uses Next.js API Routes to integrate with OpenAI GPT-4  for proposal generation and confidence scoring. Smart contracts are written in Solidity, tested and deployed via Hardhat 3 with Ignition, and deployed on a Saga chainlet for isolated, scalable execution.

Biome and ESLint are used for formatting and code quality, with GitHub Actions automating CI checks.
